shortDescription: The Atlanta Braves option in Polymarket’s Atlanta Braves vs. Philadelphia Phillies market surged to 74.5% from 47.5% one hour earlier, a 27% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects sharp volatility in the prediction market and may be tied to breaking news.
